key_insight: EPPC-CARE identifies communication behaviors in patient-provider messages while linking each label to supporting text for human review.
clinical_relevance: The framework could support larger-scale research on patient-provider communication and human-in-the-loop annotation workflows.
method: Sequentially identifies supporting text spans, broad communication categories, and specific subcategories.
Evaluated across six open-weight LLMs against supervised fine-tuning and communication-focused approaches.
Compared with human expert annotations on a 100-message subset.
evidence_signal: Using 5,516 reference annotations from 867 messages, EPPC-CARE improved Triplet F1 over EPPC-OASIS by 2.90 percentage points on average, reaching a best score of 64.4%.
watch_item: The reported performance leaves substantial annotation error, and generalizability beyond the evaluated messages remains uncertain.
paper_title: EPPC-CARE: Staged Hierarchical Annotation of Communication Behaviors in Secure Patient-Provider Messages
